role: previously inspected Final-QA Validation reused as development only
policy: For each question ID, use B6 only when training support reaches the minimum and B6 option-label macro-F1 exceeds B3 by at least the minimum margin; otherwise retain B3.

inner_selection.tie_break: higher question exact, then higher option micro-F1, then larger margin, then larger support

requirements: nested-OOF question exact is not below B3 by more than 0.001
nested-OOF option micro-F1 is not below B3 by more than 0.001
B6 is used for at least one disagreement

boundary: This is a final post-hoc development audit. Nested OOF isolates outer cases from fold-specific hyperparameter selection, but the method family was motivated by already known Validation results. No Test, confirmation, clinical-accuracy, or external-validation claim is permitted.
